title: Unit 30 Consolidation: the new democracies
goal: Consolidate the return to elections, the new institutions, justice, the crises and the limits of the new democracies.

items: I can retell in order how the countries of Latin America returned to elected government.
I can use the words for elections, constitutions, courts and crises in sentences.
I can say what was created with the *se* passive and admit a difficulty with *a pesar de*.
I can say what stopped with *dejar de* + infinitive.
I can sum up my view of the new democracies with *en resumen* and *lo más importante es que*.
